_doc: Per-navy building texture atlas of the campaign map's camps, towns and works: 4x4 cells of 512 px (2048 px before scaling), 8 px wrap gutter inside every cell, published at 1024 px with its normal map (public/textures/buildings). Array index = cell index (row-major). Read by scripts/ship-textures.mjs --set=buildings (prompts, processing) and src/ui/grand/buildingAtlas.ts (cell lookup, metres per tile). modulate: colour taming (sharp's modulate) before compositing; tile: seamless texture repeated in the shader, its long axis (grain, courses, plank rows) along the image's horizontal axis, a roof's tile columns along its vertical axis; size: metres covered by one repeat. A cell without tile is one picture laid over a whole face (a door, a gate, a window, a curtain). sheet: several banners packed in one cell (cols x rows). The Korean towns of every port use the joseon set.
style: Stylised realistic game texture in the manner of the buildings of Civilization VI: clean, crisp and readable from a distance, rich natural colour with soft painterly detail, no photographic noise, no grain, no dirt smudges. Flat orthographic view filling the whole square image edge to edge, even soft diffuse light, no baked shadows, no vignette, no perspective, no border, no frame, no text, no watermark.

joseon.name: giwa
joseon.prompt: Seamless tileable texture of a traditional Korean giwa tile roof seen straight from above: dark slate-grey fired clay tiles laid in neat straight columns running from the top edge to the bottom edge of the image, rounded convex cover tiles over concave pan tiles, about ten columns across, each column of overlapping tiles with soft highlights on the rounded tops and darker valleys between the columns, subtle blue-grey variation from tile to tile.

joseon.name: ridge
joseon.prompt: Seamless tileable texture of the side face of a Korean roof ridge (yongmaru): several horizontal courses of thin dark grey roof tiles stacked edge-on and thickly rendered in bright white lime mortar, the dark tile edges showing as crisp thin horizontal lines in the white, mostly white, the courses running horizontally across the whole image.

joseon.name: plaster
joseon.prompt: Seamless tileable texture of a clean white lime-plastered wall of a Korean hanok house: warm off-white smooth lime render with very soft trowel marks and the faintest grey weathering, even and bright, no cracks, no joints.

joseon.name: timber
joseon.prompt: Seamless tileable texture of dark brown oiled pine timber of a Korean house frame: smooth planed wood with long straight grain running horizontally across the image, warm dark walnut brown, a few faint knots, satin finish.

joseon.name: pillar
